post_commit_sha.reason: A file cannot contain the hash of its own containing commit without changing that hash.

remote_verification.procedure: Normal git push origin main, fetch origin main, then validate_live_model_009b.py with --verify-remote and a new external --report. Require local/fetched/live SHA equality, zero divergence, clean tree and exact fetched content samples.
